content_sections.heading: About NIEPMD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities (Divyangjan) is located at Muttukadu, East Coast Road, Kovalam (P.O), Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The institute functions under the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India, to provide rehabilitation, training, and research support for persons with multiple disabilities. The current notification invites qualified professionals to join the institute on a temporary consultancy assignment under specific terms and conditions.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration without any additional allowances: Lecturer (Clinical Psychology) (Consultant): Rs. 60,000/- per month. Tutor - Clinical Assistant (Occupational Therapy) (Consultant): Rs. 50,000/- per month. Rehabilitation Officer – Therapeutics (Consultant): Rs. 50,000/- per month. An annual increment at the rate of 3% shall be allowed during the term of the contract. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. The term of appointment is ordinarily for an initial period not exceeding 3 years, extendable up to a maximum of 5 years with the approval of the General Council, provided in no case shall it be extended beyond 5 years. The appointment is on a full-time basis, and candidates are not permitted to take up any other commercial assignment during the period of consultancy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their applications through online mode only. No other mode of application will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 590/- (including GST), which must be paid through online mode via RTGS, NEFT, or IMPS. No other mode of payment is accepted by the Institute. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PWD, Female, and Transgender categories are exempted from paying the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The consultant positions are filled purely on a contractual basis. Selected candidates may be posted at NIEPMD(D), Chennai, and any of its sub-centres or out-reach centres, and are liable to be transferred to offices anywhere in India under the administrative control of NIEPMD(D), Chennai. Engagement can be terminated by the competent authority at any time without assigning reasons by giving 30 days notice, or by the candidate by giving 30 days advance notice or remuneration in lieu thereof. Bringing any type of political or official interference, influence, canvassing, or pressure will render the candidate disqualified. Incomplete applications or applications submitted without requisite documents will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available under NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available for consultant positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts notified in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notified posts are Lecturer (Clinical Psychology), Tutor - Clinical Assistant (Occupational Therapy), and Rehabilitation Officer – Therapeutics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 56 years, reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the consolidated monthly salary for the Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for Lecturer (Clinical Psychology) is Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee, and who is exempted?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 590/- (including GST) paid online via RTGS/NEFT/IMPS. SC, ST, PWD, Female, and Transgender candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is within 21 days from the date of publishing the advertisement in the employment news.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one post using a single application form?
faq.answer: No, candidates wishing to apply for more than one discipline or post must submit separate online application forms along with proof of requisite fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the initial duration of the contract appointment?
faq.answer: The term of appointment is ordinarily for an initial period not exceeding 3 years, and may be extendable up to a maximum of 5 years with the approval of GC, provided in no case shall it be extended beyond 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply online for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official link at https://niepmd.nic.in/notice-category/recruitments./.
